card.name: Maculele
card.era: Documented in Santo Amaro by 1757; revived 1943
card.tagline: Afro-Brazilian stick/machete warrior dance of Bahia.
card.profile: Maculele is an Afro-Indigenous Brazilian folkloric dance from Santo Amaro, Bahia, simulating combat with pairs of sticks (grimas, ~50-60 cm of biriba wood) or, in daring versions, machetes that spark on impact. Performed in a roda to atabaque rhythms with agogo and call-and-response songs, often in Yoruba. Revived by Mestre Popo (Paulino Aluisio de Andrade) in 1943 and spread internationally by Emilia Biancardi's Viva Bahia group (English Wikipedia; Encyclopedia.com).
card.insight: Mestre Popo revived maculele in 1943 in Santo Amaro; it is now widely performed within capoeira schools worldwide (English Wikipedia).
